# victorops_maintenance_mode (Resource)

Manages a maintenance mode in VictorOps/Splunk OnCall. Create starts maintenance mode, delete ends it. No updates are supported - all fields are ForceNew.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Specific routing keys
resource "victorops_maintenance_mode" "deploy" {
  routing_keys = [victorops_routing_key.platform_alerts.name]
  purpose      = "Scheduled deployment"
}

# Global (all routing keys)
resource "victorops_maintenance_mode" "global" {
  purpose = "Infrastructure maintenance"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `purpose` (String) The reason for the maintenance mode.
- `routing_keys` (List of String) The routing keys to put into maintenance mode. An empty list indicates global maintenance mode.
- `type` (String) The type of maintenance mode. Currently only 'RoutingKeys' is supported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `instance_id` (String) The instance ID of the maintenance mode.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this is a global maintenance mode.
- `started_at` (Number) The timestamp when maintenance mode was started (milliseconds from epoch).
- `started_by` (String) The username of the user who started maintenance mode.
